# Course Report

> > The leading platform for comparing and reviewing 865+ coding bootcamps and tech courses across 388 cities worldwide, with 60,000+ alumni reviews and personalized matching tools.

Course Report is a comprehensive bootcamp discovery and comparison platform that helps prospective students find the best coding bootcamps, tech courses, and certifications. The site aggregates reviews, rankings, and detailed information on bootcamps across multiple technologies (Python, JavaScript, cloud computing, AI/ML, blockchain, etc.) and locations globally.

## Key Topics

- Coding Bootcamps
- Bootcamp Reviews
- Bootcamp Comparison
- Career Matching
- Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Generative AI & LLMs
- Data Engineering
- Blockchain & Solidity
- Game Development
- Online Learning
- Bootcamp Scholarships
- Tech Training
- Career Guidance
- Bootcamp Rankings
- Cybersecurity

## Bootcamp Discovery & Matching

- [Compare The Best Coding Bootcamps of 2026](https://www.coursereport.com): Homepage showcasing 60,000+ bootcamp reviews and comparison tools
- [Find the best bootcamp for you](https://www.coursereport.com/get-matched): Bootcamp matching quiz and recommendation service for users
- [Discover the Best Coding Bootcamps](https://www.coursereport.com/schools): Directory of 865 bootcamp courses in 20+ tech disciplines
